lines.2: After school, the basketball club normally had the place to itself, but the drama club used it whenever the schedule allowed.
lines.3: Ryuumeikan was famous even at other schools for how generously it treated clubs that produced results.
lines.4: Every club competed eagerly to prove itself.
lines.5: The drama club was no exception, despite not being an athletic club.
lines.6: 「Mm. Rehearsing on the stage--well, in the gym--really does help me focus. The basketball club isn't here today, so we can really let loose.」
lines.7: 「You there. That last line was completely flat!」
lines.9: 「Don't just read the script. Use your imagination to fill in the character's background and feelings, and become the role.」
lines.10: 「The president is even more fired up than usual, like.」
lines.11: 「By my calculations, President Konoe's motivation has risen by twenty percent.」
lines.12: 「Drama is fun, but practice has been way too hard lately, like.」
lines.14: 「You saw how well we did in the spring tournament. We can still improve a lot, so let's keep working.」
